data.title: Backtrack
data.solution:
s = input().strip()
n = int(input())

operations = []

for _ in range(n):
    operations.append(input().strip())

for op in reversed(operations):

    if op == "R":
        s = s[::-1]

    elif op[0] == "L":
        k = int(op[1:])
        k %= len(s)
        s = s[-k:] + s[:-k]

    elif op[0] == "B":
        k = int(op[1:])
        result = []

        for i in range(0, len(s), k):
            block = s[i:i + k]

            if len(block) == k:
                block = block[::-1]

            result.append(block)

        s = "".join(result)

    elif op[0] == "X":
        k = int(op[1:])
        opposite = len(s) - 1 - k

        chars = list(s)
        chars[k], chars[opposite] = chars[opposite], chars[k]
        s = "".join(chars)

print(s)

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

<b>Goal</b>

A machine transforms a string by applying a sequence of operations.

You are given the string after all operations have been performed, as well as the operations that were used.

Your task is to recover the original string, before any operation was applied.

The operations are:

- <b>R</b>: reverses the entire string.
- <b>Lk</b>: moves the first k characters to the end of the string.
- <b>Bk</b>: divides the string into blocks of k characters and reverses each complete block. A final incomplete block is left unchanged.
- <b>Xk</b>: swaps the character at position k with the character at the opposite position.

Positions start at 0.

The operations are given in the order in which they were originally performed.
Input
<b>Input</b>

<b>Line 1:</b> A string s, representing the string after all operations have been performed.

<b>Line 2:</b> An integer n, representing the number of operations.

<b>Lines 3 to n + 2:</b> One operation per line.

Each operation is one of:

<b>R</b>

<b>Lk</b>, where k is the number of positions to rotate.

<b>Bk</b>, where k is the block size.

<b>Xk</b>, where k is a character position.
Output
<b>Output</b>

<b>Line 1:</b> The original string s, before any operation was performed.
Constraints
<b>Constraints</b>

- 1 <= length(s) <= 100
- 1 <= n <= 100
- 1 <= k < length(s) for <b>Lk</b> and <b>Bk</b>
- 0 <= k < length(s) for <b>Xk</b>
- s contains only printable ASCII characters.
- s contains no spaces.
Example
Input
dfbace
3
R
L2
X1
Output
abcdef
